newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids extend slide.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids extend slide.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids continued to slide on Tuesday, shadowing MGE futures, several cash grain dealers said.
Merchants said Monday's USDA acreage forecast continued to garner attention. The report put spring wheat plantings at 19.1 million acres, above expectations for 18.1 million.

Weather was also improving with rains falling across the drier regions of Montana, North Dakota and Minnesota. Dealers estimated rainfall amounts from 0.50 to 1.00 inch across portions of those states, increasing soil moisture in some areas that had been in need of rain.

"They're finally starting to get some moisture in the east which could save a few of the guys who were really struggling with dry soils," a Montana dealer said, referring to the eastern part of the state.
"Nobody wants to sell at these prices," a North Dakota dealer said.
